run_test_separation: run the test script to separate mixed audio from two speakers using visual lip cues
build_model_nets: build neural network modules including lipreading, facial attributes, UNet, and vocal attributes
get_separated_audio: get separated audio signals from model mask predictions using inverse STFT reconstruction
audio_normalize: normalize audio samples to a target RMS level and return the normalization factor
clip_audio: clip audio signal values to the range [-1.0, 1.0] to prevent overflow
